outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B contains phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.

The top row shows representative flow cytometry dot plots (raw single-experiment data, not an average, so the check does not apply to them). The bottom bar chart shows mean ± SEM (n=3) percentages, and individual replicate values are overlaid as distinct point markers (circles, squares, triangles) on each bar.
The top row shows a representative flow cytometry dot plot (raw data, not applicable). The bottom bar chart shows mean ± SD (n=3), with individual data points overlaid on each bar as markers.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized (Z-score) expression values; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Both bar charts show mean ± SEM (n=3) relative mRNA levels for multiple genes, with individual replicate data points overlaid as distinct markers (circles, squares, triangles) on each bar.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
